$comment: GREP_SUMMARY: node, node-configs, declarative, apply, schema, context, project, module, domain, secrets, TLS, wildcard, contexts, tor | STRUCTURE: ▶ node.yaml → ┌contexts+node+domain┐ → ◇ validate ← ⊕ modules+projects+secrets+firewall → ⚡ registry | MODULE_CONTRACT: @purpose Validate node.yaml declarative desired state for platform deploy and diff computation; @scope Full node declaration — contexts, node, modules, projects, firewall, secrets, domain, postgres, repos; @invariants Backward-compatible — all legacy fields continue to validate unchanged; @rationale Single source of truth for make bootstrap-node NODE=<name> — describes desired state, used by diff engine to compute changes vs actual state on VPS | LDD: IMP:9[SCHEMA_VALIDATE] validate() → check required fields [node, modules] → assert property types → validate enum (project.type) → assert minLength → pattern validation → ⚡ schema registry OK
title: NodeDeclaration
description: Schema for node.yaml — declares a platform node, its contexts, desired module/project state, firewall rules, secrets, and declarative deploy configuration

context.description: Deployment context identifier (e.g. production, staging). Legacy field — use contexts array for new configs.

contexts.description: Declared deployment contexts — each context defines an isolated environment with its own node-configs and hermes-agent repos

domain.description: Wildcard TLS domain (e.g. tronyx.ru) — acme.sh issues *.domain via DNS-01 challenge; auto-renewed via cron

email.description: Contact email for acme.sh TLS certificate registration and notifications

acme_dns_plugin.description: DNS provider plugin for acme.sh DNS-01 wildcard challenge. webnames=Webnames.ru API, cf=Cloudflare, dp=DigitalOcean, generic=any acme.sh dnsapi plugin (set via env var)

host.description: IP address or FQDN of the node

owner_key.description: SSH public key of the node owner (added to platform user authorized_keys)

ci_deploy_key.description: SSH public key for ci-deploy user (used with command= restrict)

extra_ports.description: Additional TCP ports to allow inbound beyond baseline 22/80/443

secrets.description: Secrets configuration — references to encrypted files and required API keys sourced from env vars at runtime

enc_file.description: Path to SOPS/age encrypted secrets file relative to node-configs repo

env_var.description: Environment variable name that supplies this secret at runtime — never written to disk

required.description: List of required secrets sourced from env vars — runtime only, never persisted to disk (see D-6: secrets in env/tmpfs)

tor.description: Tor + Privoxy proxy configuration for bypassing IP restrictions. Uses host-level systemd services (Option A architecture). HTTP_PROXY passed to containers via secrets.env at host.docker.internal:8118.

enabled.description: Enable Tor + Privoxy proxy on this node. Required for Telegram Bot API access from IP-restricted regions (e.g. Russia).

skip_verify.description: Skip Tor circuit verification during bootstrap (useful when bridges are not yet configured)

bridges_file.description: Path to obfs4 bridges file relative to node config directory (e.g. overlays/tor/bridges.txt)

enabled.description: Whether this module should be deployed

config_overlay.description: Path to node-specific config overlay relative to node-configs repo

modules.description: List of modules to deploy on this node

domain.description: FQDN for HTTP-routable projects (required for frontend/landing types)

database.description: Database name in postgres (required for backend/bot types)

context.description: Context name this project belongs to — must reference a contexts[].name entry

projects.description: Registered projects deployed on this node

items.description: Database name to create in postgres on bootstrap
